service: form a source-bound licensed editorial state before prose is commissioned
admission: ActivityStreams Offer<ServiceSolicitation> addressed to the provider, followed by Accept<ServiceContract> carrying the exact provider offer
preconditions: the demand names one assignment and carries its admitted research packet
the assignment source URLs are a subset of the packet source URLs
the demand carries the publication's genre law and publication-policy digests plus the exact genre evidence budget
the customer accepts the zero-price offer and its exact demand digest
postconditions: the provider returns source-bound assertions and a licensed plan, or a typed refusal before writer inference
the provider measures how much prose the admitted assertions can sustain and refuses an underfunded genre before writer inference
every planned passage cites one or more admitted source assertions
demand, angle, and beat remain editorial pressure and are never promoted to source evidence
the provider writes only its own receipt and never writes the customer's corpus or ledger
the customer independently admits or refuses the returned state
